svg.title: NYC Taxi Data Engineering — M2.2 local retrieval
svg.desc: sbt retrieve and runMain LocalRetrieval parse the configuration, lock RAW_DIR, and process each month. An accepted file is reused after a full Spark read. Otherwise the file is downloaded with bounded retries, every column is decoded, and the file and its provenance sidecar are promoted atomically. Each month yields a result, and the run exits with 0, 1, 2, or 130.

g.text: exo1_data_retrieval: TLC HTTPS files into data/raw, each accepted only after a full Spark read
then one month at a time
LIMIT: advisory OS lock on one host.
does not stop the next one
